shapley_implementation.name: Custom, in-repo. Three separate hand-written implementations, none under version control (the project has no git history - confirmed by driver-script comments that fall back to a model file SHA-256 'because git rev-parse is unavailable'). (1) factorial_arms_shapley.py :: exact_shapley() - exact closed-form 3-player Shapley over the {SRT, AAV, FUS} binary-intervention coalition game, pure Python (itertools + math.factorial), no third-party dependency; produced data/factorial_arms_shapley.json and the _day45/_day90/_day180 variants. (2) task5_paired_contrasts.py :: shapley_with_ci() - the same exact 3-player intervention Shapley wrapped in a NumPy bootstrap for confidence intervals; produced data/shapley_with_ci.json. (3) ml/robustness_audit.py :: shapley_effects() (called via niemann_pick_shapley.py) - a permutation-based parameter-level Shapley-effect estimator (Song, Nelson & Staum 2016) by nested Monte Carlo, depends on NumPy and SALib.sample.sobol; produced data/shapley_niemann_pick_c.json (the Niemann-Pick C ST>1 cross-check).

That default set on LS6 is: TACC, intel/19.1.1, impi/19.0.9, python3/3.9.7, autotools/1.4, cmake/4.1.1, pmix/3.2.3, xalt/3.1. This was verified today with 'pip show' / 'python3 -c import'. No requirements.txt, environment.yml, conda lock file, conda environment, virtualenv, or 'pip freeze' capture was ever created for this project (searched all of $HOME and $WORK). (c) Every reported-output job ran after that date: the LSD Sobol JSONs on 2026-07-20 through 2026-07-27, factorial_arms_shapley*.json on 2026-07-30, gm2_full14_*.json / convergence_grid.json / cross-disease equal_width & tier1_promotion variants on 2026-08-08 to 2026-08-09, and the round-4 outputs (convergence_grid_second_order_true.json, equal_width_cv.json, fus_protocol_params.json, parameter_provenance.json) on 2026-08-26.
